rule_metadata.description: Pointer-owned memory or resource is not released

diagnostic.message: Memory leak: allocation stored in 'expectation' may not be freed

occurrences.rationale: The newly allocated TypedExpectation immediately transfers ownership into std::shared_ptr<ExpectationBase>, which is retained in the mocker's shared-pointer vector. FunctionMocker destruction invokes VerifyAndClearExpectationsLocked, which releases these owners outside the mutex. Returning a reference does not lose ownership. This is normal library ownership, not an intentional leaking test fixture.

notes.message: 'untyped_expectation' assigned a possibly-null value here (callee may return null)

occurrences.rationale: UntypedFindMatchingExpectation can return nullptr, but the returned pointer is const and found is the const expression untyped_expectation != nullptr. The reported dereference occurs only inside if (found && !is_excessive), so a null pointer cannot reach it. This is a guarded library path, not a death-test dereference.

cwes.name: CWE-772
cwes.description: Resource not released after its effective lifetime

diagnostic.message: Memory leak: allocation stored in 'fileout' may not be freed

occurrences.rationale: OpenFileForWriting returns the acquired FILE* to its caller; the handle is not lost at the reported function exit. All four source call sites retain the returned handle and fclose it after output. This finding mistakes a library factory's ownership transfer for a local resource leak; it is not a claim that unrelated exceptional caller paths were exhaustively verified.
